{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now compute mean age, excluding rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
mean_age = sales_clean[sales_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding -1 and QA orders): {mean_age}")"}
